**Geographic focus:**

**Temporal focus:**
T1. Historical observation — YES *(July CPI, PCE data, prior monthly index performance)*
T2. Forward-looking immediate — YES *(September Fed meeting, Sept 4 jobs report, rate hike probability)*
T3. Long-term development — NO

**Synopsis:**
U.S. equities sold off on Aug 31, 2026, driven by two converging shocks: (1) hawkish remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole signaling a possible rate hike if inflation doesn't ease to 2%, and (2) U.S.-Iran military clashes disrupting Strait of Hormuz oil flows, lifting Brent crude ~1.71% and stoking inflation fears. Rate hike odds for September jumped from 41.4% to >60% per CME FedWatch. The DJI fell 0.65%, S&P 500 -0.40%, Nasdaq -0.29%. Energy stocks outperformed; utilities lagged sharply on California wildfire liability concerns. AI/chip names (Nvidia, Intel, TXN) were resilient. Breadth was decisively negative on both NYSE and Nasdaq.
